verdicts.file: Ultimi ruderi chiesa di S.Pietro (necropoli etrusca di Norchia) - panoramio.jpg
verdicts.note: Ruins of a masonry church: brick/stone walls, a rounded apse, narrow arched window openings. No rock-cut Etruscan tomb or necropolis visible.

verdicts.file: Ruderi castello dei De Vico (necropoli etrusca di Norchia) - panoramio.jpg
verdicts.note: Overgrown green hill seen through branches with a few bare masonry fragments at the top; no tombs, so the Etruscan necropolis is not recognisable.
